hotel.name: Anantara Convento di Amalfi Grand Hotel

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a converted 13th-century monastery with its original cloister and church.
verified_facts.excerpt: Converted 13th-century monastery with the original cloister and church

verified_facts.text: The hotel was originally a 13th-century Capuchin convent built into the cliffside.
verified_facts.excerpt: a 13th-century Capuchin convent built into the cliffside

verified_facts.text: The hotel is built into the cliffside overlooking the harbour, 600 metres from the Amalfi town centre.
verified_facts.excerpt: is built into the cliffside overlooking the harbour, just 600 m from the town centre

verified_facts.text: Almost all rooms and suites look directly out to sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: almost all of our 52 suites and rooms look directly out to sea

verified_facts.text: The rooms were originally the monks' quarters.
verified_facts.excerpt: Originally the monks’ quarters, these accommodations maintain their solemn simplicity

verified_facts.text: The rooms and suites were renovated in 2023.
verified_facts.excerpt: Completely renovated in 2023

verified_facts.text: Suites offer options such as a private terrace with a jacuzzi, views of the cloisters, or a standalone suite in the lemon grove.
verified_facts.excerpt: Opt for a private terrace with a jacuzzi, views of the cloisters, or a standalone suite in the lemon grove.

verified_facts.text: The Suite Del Priore has original frescoes and cloister views.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Suite Del Priore – named for its setting in the old priory – has original frescoes and cloister views

verified_facts.text: The Suite Dell'Eremita has its own lemon grove.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Suite Dell’Eremita has its own lemon grove

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a heated infinity pool available all season.
verified_facts.excerpt: Heated infinity pool available all season

verified_facts.text: The swimming pool and gym are located on the cliffside.
verified_facts.excerpt: has a spectacular swimming pool and gym located on the cliffside

verified_facts.text: The hotel has an Anantara Spa.
verified_facts.excerpt: There is also the award-winning Anantara Spa.

verified_facts.text: Guests have access to the Lido degli Artisti beach club, five minutes away by boat, with charges applying.
verified_facts.excerpt: offers access to the Lido degli Artisti beach club which is five minutes away by boat. Please note that charges apply.

verified_facts.text: A twelfth-century chapel on site is used for weddings.
verified_facts.excerpt: XII century chapel for weddings

verified_facts.text: Behind the monastery-hermitage is part of the old Arab-Norman cloister, colonnaded with interlaced arches.
verified_facts.excerpt: is part of the old Arab-Norman cloister, collonaded with interlaced arches

verified_facts.text: The convent became a hotel in 1882.
verified_facts.excerpt: in 1882, by which time the culture of the European Grand Tour amongst wealthy British and North American youth of rank had peaked, the convent finally transmogrified into a hotel

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits 80 metres above the sea, with views over Amalfi and the Gulf of Salerno.
verified_facts.excerpt: From this cliffside-carved eyrie 80 metres above the sea, the whole of picaresque, rollicking

verified_facts.text: A long loggia laden with bougainvillea, the Passeggiata dei Monaci, runs along the terraces.
verified_facts.excerpt: under the long, lazy loggia laden with vibrant fuschia bougainvillaea – the Passeggiata dei Monaci

verified_facts.text: The hotel has two restaurants: Dei Cappuccini, the main restaurant, and La Locanda della Canonica, for informal outdoor lunch.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dei Cappuccini, the main restaurant, and La Locanda della Canonica, ideal for an informal outdoor lunch

verified_facts.text: Chef Claudio Lanuto uses seasonal ingredients grown in the convent garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: chef Claudio Lanuto utilises seasonal ingredients grown in the “convent garden”

verified_facts.text: The hotel works with a Franciscan friar from Ravello who introduces guests to the chapel or takes them on tours of Ravello.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel works with a local Franciscan friar from Ravello, Friar Marcus, to introduce interested guests to the chapel, or whisk them on tours of Ravello

verified_facts.text: Hotel experiences include breathwork and sound healing in the convent.
verified_facts.excerpt: Divine wellness: breathwork and sound healing in the convent

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a one-and-a-half-hour drive from Naples International Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: is a one-and-a-half-hour drive from Naples International Airport

verified_facts.text: Valet parking is offered with a daily charge.
verified_facts.excerpt: offers valet parking with a daily charge

verified_facts.text: The building has many steps in different directions, but there are lifts accessing every level.
verified_facts.excerpt: with any number of steps going in multiple different directions, does not initially scream accessibility, but there are three accessible rooms and lifts accessing every level

verified_facts.text: Pets are welcome with prior reservation, subject to a nightly maximum.
verified_facts.excerpt: welcomes pets with prior reservation, although we have a maximum capacity per night

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a panoramic gym with Technogym equipment.
verified_facts.excerpt: Panoramic gym (Technogym equipment)

verified_facts.text: Amalfi lies near the Path of the Gods hike between Praiano and Positano.
verified_facts.excerpt: Amalfi is on the precipice of the Sentiero Degli Dei, the “Path of the Gods” hike between Praiano and Positano
